correctness.rationale: The density indicator of an order polytope is log-supermodular due to closure under pointwise minima/maxima, yielding the FKG lower bound; nonindependent comparable-coordinate marginals make the inequality strict except for an antichain. Conditional on two linear extensions, every admissible merge is a Catalan ballot merge; if extensions differ, the alternating ballot merge is excluded, giving rigidity of the chain upper extremizer. The exact product-poset volume ratio and star beta integral supply separate checks. Exhaustive exact enumeration checked 1099 naturally oriented relation systems through five elements, including boundary cases, and seven stars; infinite conclusions rest on the analytic proof, not the checker.

value.rationale: The natural geometric observable is the relative volume of comparable pairs of a canonical poset polytope. The theorem gives a global sharp envelope with complete extremizer classification, connecting FKG geometry to Catalan ballot constraints and the product-poset extension enumerator. The star evaluation demonstrates quantitatively that a single layer of order constraints produces a nonconstant square-root change relative to cube behavior. Both inequalities and equality classifications address the whole family rather than a textbook computation of one isolated example.
